verses.original: וִיהוֹרָ֣ם בֶּן־ אַחְאָ֗ב מָלַ֤ךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן בִּשְׁנַת֙ שְׁמֹנֶ֣ה עֶשְׂרֵ֔ה לִיהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֖ךְ שְׁתֵּים־ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wî·hō·w·rām ben- ’aḥ·’āḇ mā·laḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl bə·šō·mə·rō·wn biš·naṯ šə·mō·neh ‘eś·rêh lî·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh way·yim·lōḵ šə·têm- ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh
verses.literal: In the eighteenth . . . year of Jehoshaphat’s reign over Judah Jehoram son of Ahab became king of Israel and he reigned in Samaria twelve . . . years
verses.literalPt: E JORÃO, filho de Acabe, começou a reinar sobre Israel, em Samaria, no décimo oitavo ano de Jeosafá, rei de Judá; e reinou doze anos.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲשֶׂ֤ה הָרַע֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה רַ֕ק לֹ֥א כְאָבִ֖יו וּכְאִמּ֑וֹ וַיָּ֙סַר֙ אֶת־ מַצְּבַ֣ת הַבַּ֔עַל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה אָבִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śeh hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh raq lō ḵə·’ā·ḇîw ū·ḵə·’im·mōw way·yā·sar ’eṯ- maṣ·ṣə·ḇaṯ hab·ba·‘al ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh ’ā·ḇîw
verses.literal: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD but not as his father and mother had done He removed the sacred pillar of Baal that his father had made
verses.literalPt: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR; porém não como seu pai, nem como sua mãe; porque tirou a estátua de Baal, que seu pai fizera.

verses.original: רַ֠ק בְּחַטֹּ֞אות יָרָבְעָ֧ם בֶּֽן־ נְבָ֛ט אֲשֶׁר־ הֶחֱטִ֥יא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל דָּבֵ֑ק לֹא־ סָ֖ר מִמֶּֽנָּה׃ס
verses.transliteration: raq bə·ḥaṭ·ṭō·wṯ yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ben- nə·ḇāṭ ’ă·šer- he·ḥĕ·ṭî ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl dā·ḇêq lō- sār mim·men·nāh
verses.literal: Nevertheless he clung to the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit he did not turn away from them
verses.literalPt: Contudo aderiu aos pecados de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, com que fizera Israel pecar; não se apartou deles.

verses.original: וּמֵישַׁ֥ע מֶֽלֶךְ־ מוֹאָ֖ב הָיָ֣ה נֹקֵ֑ד וְהֵשִׁ֤יב לְמֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאָה־ אֶ֣לֶף כָּרִ֔ים וּמֵ֥אָה אֶ֖לֶף אֵילִ֥ים צָֽמֶר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mê·ša‘ me·leḵ- mō·w·’āḇ hā·yāh nō·qêḏ wə·hê·šîḇ lə·me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl mê·’āh- ’e·lep̄ kā·rîm ū·mê·’āh ’e·lep̄ ’ê·lîm ṣā·mer
verses.literal: Now Mesha king of Moab was a sheep breeder and he would render to the king of Israel a hundred thousand lambs and the wool of a hundred thousand rams
verses.literalPt: Então Mesa, rei dos moabitas, era criador de gado, e pagava de tributo, ao rei de Israel, cem mil cordeiros, e cem mil carneiros com a sua lã.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֖י כְּמ֣וֹת אַחְאָ֑ב וַיִּפְשַׁ֥ע מֶֽלֶךְ־ מוֹאָ֖ב בְּמֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·mō·wṯ ’aḥ·’āḇ way·yip̄·ša‘ me·leḵ- mō·w·’āḇ bə·me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: But after the death of Ahab the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel
verses.literalPt: Sucedeu, porém, que, morrendo Acabe, o rei dos moabitas se rebelou contra o rei de Israel.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֞א הַמֶּ֧לֶךְ יְהוֹרָ֛ם בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא מִשֹּׁמְר֑וֹן וַיִּפְקֹ֖ד אֶת־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê ham·me·leḵ yə·hō·w·rām bay·yō·wm ha·hū miš·šō·mə·rō·wn way·yip̄·qōḏ ’eṯ- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: So at that time King Jehoram set out from Samaria and mobilized all Israel
verses.literalPt: Por isso Jorão ao mesmo tempo saiu de Samaria, e fez revista de todo o Israel.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֡לֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ אֶל־ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֨ט מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֜ה לֵאמֹ֗ר מֶ֤לֶךְ מוֹאָב֙ פָּשַׁ֣ע בִּ֔י הֲתֵלֵ֥ךְ אִתִּ֛י אֶל־ מוֹאָ֖ב לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶעֱלֶ֔ה כָּמ֧וֹנִי כָמ֛וֹךָ כְּעַמִּ֥י כְעַמֶּ֖ךָ כְּסוּסַ֥י כְּסוּסֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ way·yiš·laḥ ’el- yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh lê·mōr me·leḵ mō·w·’āḇ pā·ša‘ bî hă·ṯê·lêḵ ’it·tî ’el- mō·w·’āḇ lam·mil·ḥā·māh way·yō·mer ’e·‘ĕ·leh kā·mō·w·nî ḵā·mō·w·ḵā kə·‘am·mî ḵə·‘am·me·ḵā kə·sū·say kə·sū·se·ḵā
verses.literal: And he sent a message to Jehoshaphat king of Judah The king of Moab has rebelled against me Will you go with me to fight against Moab I will go replied Jehoshaphat I am as you are my people are your people and my horses are your horses
verses.literalPt: E foi, e mandou dizer a Jeosafá, rei de Judá: O rei dos moabitas se rebelou contra mim; irás tu comigo à guerra contra os moabitas? E disse ele: Subirei; e eu serei como tu, o meu povo como o teu povo, e os meus cavalos como os teus cavalos.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אֵי־ זֶ֥ה הַדֶּ֖רֶךְ נַעֲלֶ֑ה וַיֹּ֕אמֶר דֶּ֖רֶךְ מִדְבַּ֥ר אֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê- zeh had·de·reḵ na·‘ă·leh way·yō·mer de·reḵ miḏ·bar ’ĕ·ḏō·wm
verses.literal: Then he asked Which way shall we go up By way of the Desert of Edom replied Joram
verses.literalPt: E ele disse: Por que caminho subiremos? Então disse ele: Pelo caminho do deserto de Edom.

verses.original: וַיֵּלֶךְ֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל וּמֶֽלֶך־ יְהוּדָה֙ וּמֶ֣לֶךְ אֱד֔וֹם וַיָּסֹ֕בּוּ דֶּ֖רֶךְ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וְלֹא־ הָיָ֨ה מַ֧יִם לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֛ה וְלַבְּהֵמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּרַגְלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl ū·me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏå̄h ū·me·leḵ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm way·yā·sōb·bū de·reḵ šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm wə·lō- hā·yāh ma·yim lam·ma·ḥă·neh wə·lab·bə·hê·māh ’ă·šer bə·raḡ·lê·hem
verses.literal: So the king of Israel the king of Judah and the king of Edom set out and after they had traveled a roundabout route for seven days they had no . . . water for their army or for their . . . animals
verses.literalPt: E partiram o rei de Israel, o rei de Judá e o rei de Edom; e andaram rodeando com uma marcha de sete dias, e não havia água para o exército e nem para o gado que os seguia.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲהָ֕הּ כִּֽי־ קָרָ֣א יְהוָ֗ה לִשְׁלֹ֙שֶׁת֙ הַמְּלָכִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה לָתֵ֥ת אוֹתָ֖ם בְּיַד־ מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·hāh kî- qā·rā Yah·weh liš·lō·šeṯ ham·mə·lā·ḵîm hā·’êl·leh lā·ṯêṯ ’ō·w·ṯām bə·yaḏ- mō·w·’āḇ
verses.literal: Alas said the king of Israel for the LORD has summoned these three kings to deliver them into the hand of Moab
verses.literalPt: Então disse o rei de Israel: Ah! o SENHOR chamou a estes três reis, para entregá-los nas mãos dos moabitas.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָ֗ט הַאֵ֨ין פֹּ֤ה נָבִיא֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וְנִדְרְשָׁ֥ה אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה מֵאוֹת֑וֹ וַ֠יַּעַן אֶחָ֞ד מֵעַבְדֵ֤י מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיֹּ֔אמֶר פֹּ֚ה אֱלִישָׁ֣ע בֶּן־ שָׁפָ֔ט אֲשֶׁר־ יָ֥צַק מַ֖יִם עַל־ יְדֵ֥י אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ ha·’ên pōh nā·ḇî Yah·weh wə·niḏ·rə·šāh ’eṯ- Yah·weh mê·’ō·w·ṯōw way·ya·‘an ’e·ḥāḏ mê·‘aḇ·ḏê me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mer pōh ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ ben- šā·p̄āṭ ’ă·šer- yā·ṣaq ma·yim ‘al- yə·ḏê ’ê·lî·yā·hū
verses.literal: But Jehoshaphat asked Is there no prophet of the LORD here Let us inquire of the LORD through him And one of the servants of the king of Israel . . . answered Elisha son of Shaphat is here He used to pour water on the hands of Elijah
verses.literalPt: E disse Jeosafá: Não há aqui algum profeta do SENHOR, para que consultemos ao SENHOR por ele? Então respondeu um dos servos do rei de Israel, dizendo: Aqui está Eliseu, filho de Safate, que derramava água sobre as mãos de Elias.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ יְה֣וֹשָׁפָ֔ט יֵ֥שׁ אוֹת֖וֹ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּרְד֣וּ אֵלָ֗יו מֶ֧לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וִיהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט וּמֶ֥לֶךְ אֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ yêš ’ō·w·ṯōw də·ḇar- Yah·weh way·yê·rə·ḏū ’ê·lāw me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl wî·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ ū·me·leḵ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm
verses.literal: Jehoshaphat affirmed The word of the LORD is with him So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him
verses.literalPt: E disse Jeosafá: Está com ele a palavra do SENHOR. Então o rei de Israel, Jeosafá, e o rei de Edom desceram a ter com ele.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֱלִישָׁ֜ע אֶל־ מֶ֤לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מַה־ לִּ֣י וָלָ֔ךְ לֵ֚ךְ אֶל־ נְבִיאֵ֣י אָבִ֔יךָ וְאֶל־ נְבִיאֵ֖י אִמֶּ֑ךָ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַ֗ל כִּֽי־ קָרָ֤א יְהוָה֙ לִשְׁלֹ֙שֶׁת֙ הַמְּלָכִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה לָתֵ֥ת אוֹתָ֖ם בְּיַד־ מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ ’el- me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl mah- lî wā·lāḵ lêḵ ’el- nə·ḇî·’ê ’ā·ḇî·ḵā wə·’el- nə·ḇî·’ê ’im·me·ḵā way·yō·mer lōw me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl ’al kî- qā·rā Yah·weh liš·lō·šeṯ ham·mə·lā·ḵîm hā·’êl·leh lā·ṯêṯ ’ō·w·ṯām bə·yaḏ- mō·w·’āḇ
verses.literal: Elisha, however said to the king of Israel What have we to do . . . with each other Go to the prophets of your father and . . . of your mother No replied the king of Israel for it is the LORD who has summoned these three kings to deliver them into the hand of Moab
verses.literalPt: Mas Eliseu disse ao rei de Israel: Que tenho eu contigo? Vai aos profetas de teu pai e aos profetas de tua mãe. Porém o rei de Israel lhe disse: Não, porque o SENHOR chamou a estes três reis para entregá-los nas mãos dos moabitas.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלִישָׁ֗ע חַי־ יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָמַ֣דְתִּי לְפָנָ֔יו כִּ֗י לוּלֵ֛י פְּנֵ֛י יְהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֖ה אֲנִ֣י נֹשֵׂ֑א אִם־ אַבִּ֥יט אֵלֶ֖יךָ וְאִם־ אֶרְאֶֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ ḥay- Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ă·šer ‘ā·maḏ·tî lə·p̄ā·nāw kî lū·lê pə·nê yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh ’ă·nî nō·śê ’im- ’ab·bîṭ ’ê·le·ḵā wə·’im- ’er·’e·kā
verses.literal: Then Elisha said As surely as the LORD of Hosts lives before whom I stand were it not for my regard for the presence of Jehoshaphat king of Judah I would not look at you or acknowledge you
verses.literalPt: E disse Eliseu: Vive o SENHOR dos Exércitos, em cuja presença estou, que se eu não respeitasse a presença de Jeosafá, rei de Judá, não olharia para ti nem te veria.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֖ה קְחוּ־ לִ֣י מְנַגֵּ֑ן וְהָיָה֙ כְּנַגֵּ֣ן הַֽמְנַגֵּ֔ן וַתְּהִ֥י עָלָ֖יו יַד־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh qə·ḥū- lî mə·nag·gên wə·hā·yāh kə·nag·gên ham·nag·gên wat·tə·hî ‘ā·lāw yaḏ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: But now bring me a harpist And while the harpist played the hand of the LORD came upon Elisha
verses.literalPt: Ora, pois, trazei-me um músico. E sucedeu que, tocando o músico, veio sobre ele a mão do SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה עָשֹׂ֛ה הַנַּ֥חַל הַזֶּ֖ה גֵּבִ֥ים׀ גֵּבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ‘ā·śōh han·na·ḥal haz·zeh gê·ḇîm gê·ḇîm
verses.literal: and he said This is what the LORD says Dig this valley full of ditches
verses.literalPt: E disse: Assim diz o SENHOR: Fazei neste vale muitas covas.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ כֹ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה לֹֽא־ תִרְא֥וּ ר֙וּחַ֙ וְלֹֽא־ תִרְא֣וּ גֶ֔שֶׁם וְהַנַּ֥חַל הַה֖וּא יִמָּ֣לֵא מָ֑יִם וּשְׁתִיתֶ֛ם אַתֶּ֥ם וּמִקְנֵיכֶ֖ם וּֽבְהֶמְתְּכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh lō- ṯir·’ū rū·aḥ wə·lō- ṯir·’ū ḡe·šem wə·han·na·ḥal ha·hū yim·mā·lê mā·yim ū·šə·ṯî·ṯem ’at·tem ū·miq·nê·ḵem ū·ḇə·hem·tə·ḵem
verses.literal: For . . . the LORD says You will not see wind . . . . . . or rain but the valley will be filled with water and you will drink you and your cattle and your animals
verses.literalPt: Porque assim diz o SENHOR: Não vereis vento, e não vereis chuva; todavia este vale se encherá de tanta água, que bebereis vós, o vosso gado e os vossos animais.

verses.original: וְנָקַ֥ל זֹ֖את בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְנָתַ֥ן אֶת־ מוֹאָ֖ב בְּיֶדְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·qal zōṯ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh wə·nā·ṯan ’eṯ- mō·w·’āḇ bə·yeḏ·ḵem
verses.literal: This is a simple matter in the sight of the LORD and He will also deliver the Moabites into your hand
verses.literalPt: E ainda isto é pouco aos olhos do SENHOR; também entregará ele os moabitas nas vossas mãos.

verses.original: וְהִכִּיתֶ֞ם כָּל־ עִ֤יר מִבְצָר֙ וְכָל־ עִ֣יר מִבְח֔וֹר וְכָל־ עֵ֥ץ טוֹב֙ תַּפִּ֔ילוּ וְכָל־ מַעְיְנֵי־ מַ֖יִם תִּסְתֹּ֑מוּ וְכֹל֙ הַחֶלְקָ֣ה הַטּוֹבָ֔ה תַּכְאִ֖בוּ בָּאֲבָנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hik·kî·ṯem kāl- ‘îr miḇ·ṣār wə·ḵāl ‘îr miḇ·ḥō·wr wə·ḵāl ‘êṣ ṭō·wḇ tap·pî·lū wə·ḵāl ma‘·yə·nê- ma·yim tis·tō·mū wə·ḵōl ha·ḥel·qāh haṭ·ṭō·w·ḇāh taḵ·’i·ḇū bā·’ă·ḇā·nîm
verses.literal: And you shall attack every fortified city and every city of importance You shall cut down every good tree stop up every spring . . . and ruin every good field with stones
verses.literalPt: E ferireis a todas as cidades fortes, e a todas as cidades escolhidas, e todas as boas árvores cortareis, e entupireis todas as fontes de água, e danificareis com pedras todos os bons campos.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י בַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ כַּעֲל֣וֹת הַמִּנְחָ֔ה וְהִנֵּה־ מַ֥יִם בָּאִ֖ים מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ אֱד֑וֹם וַתִּמָּלֵ֥א הָאָ֖רֶץ אֶת־ הַמָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḇab·bō·qer ka·‘ă·lō·wṯ ham·min·ḥāh wə·hin·nêh- ma·yim bā·’îm mid·de·reḵ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm wat·tim·mā·lê hā·’ā·reṣ ’eṯ- ham·mā·yim
verses.literal: The next morning . . . at the time of the morning sacrifice . . . water suddenly flowed from the direction of Edom and filled the land
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, pela manhã, oferecendo-se a oferta de alimentos, eis que vinham as águas pelo caminho de Edom; e a terra se encheu de água.

verses.original: וְכָל־ מוֹאָב֙ שָֽׁמְע֔וּ כִּֽי־ עָל֥וּ הַמְּלָכִ֖ים לְהִלָּ֣חֶם בָּ֑ם וַיִּצָּעֲק֗וּ מִכֹּ֨ל חֹגֵ֤ר חֲגֹרָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה וַיַּעַמְד֖וּ עַֽל־ הַגְּבֽוּל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl mō·w·’āḇ šā·mə·‘ū kî- ‘ā·lū ham·mə·lā·ḵîm lə·hil·lā·ḥem bām way·yiṣ·ṣā·‘ă·qū mik·kōl ḥō·ḡêr ḥă·ḡō·rāh wā·ma‘·lāh way·ya·‘am·ḏū ‘al- hag·gə·ḇūl
verses.literal: Now all the Moabites had heard that the kings had come up to fight against them So all who could bear arms . . . young and old were summoned and stationed at the border
verses.literalPt: Ouvindo, pois, todos os moabitas que os reis tinham subido para pelejarem contra eles, convocaram a todos os que estavam em idade de cingir cinto e daí para cima, e puseram-se às fronteiras.

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכִּ֣ימוּ בַבֹּ֔קֶר וְהַשֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ זָרְחָ֣ה עַל־ הַמָּ֑יִם וַיִּרְא֨וּ מוֹאָ֥ב מִנֶּ֛גֶד אֶת־ הַמַּ֖יִם אֲדֻמִּ֥ים כַּדָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·kî·mū ḇab·bō·qer wə·haš·še·meš zā·rə·ḥāh ‘al- ham·mā·yim way·yir·’ū mō·w·’āḇ min·ne·ḡeḏ ’eṯ- ham·ma·yim ’ă·ḏum·mîm kad·dām
verses.literal: When they got up early in the morning the sun was shining on the water and it looked as red as blood to the Moabites across the way
verses.literalPt: E, levantando-se de madrugada, e saindo o sol sobre as águas, viram os moabitas, defronte deles, as águas vermelhas como sangue.

verses.original: וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ דָּ֣ם זֶ֔ה הָחֳרֵ֤ב נֶֽחֶרְבוּ֙ הַמְּלָכִ֔ים וַיַּכּ֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־ רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְעַתָּ֥ה לַשָּׁלָ֖ל מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū dām zeh hā·ḥo·rêḇ ne·ḥer·ḇū ham·mə·lā·ḵîm way·yak·kū ’îš ’eṯ- rê·‘ê·hū wə·‘at·tāh laš·šā·lāl mō·w·’āḇ
verses.literal: This . . . is blood they exclaimed The kings have clashed swords and slaughtered one another Now to the plunder Moab
verses.literalPt: E disseram: Isto é sangue; certamente que os reis se destruíram à espada e se mataram um ao outro! Agora, pois, à presa, moabitas!

verses.original: וַיָּבֹאוּ֮ אֶל־ מַחֲנֵ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַיָּקֻ֤מוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיַּכּ֣וּ אֶת־ מוֹאָ֔ב וַיָּנֻ֖סוּ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיָּבוֹ בָ֔הּ וְהַכּ֖וֹת אֶת־ מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- ma·ḥă·nêh yiś·rā·’êl way·yā·qu·mū yiś·rā·’êl way·yak·kū ’eṯ- mō·w·’āḇ way·yā·nu·sū mip·pə·nê·hem way·yå̄·ḇō ḇāh wə·hak·kō·wṯ ’eṯ- mō·w·’āḇ
verses.literal: But when the Moabites came to the camp of Israel the Israelites rose up and attacked them and they fled before them So the Israelites invaded their land and struck down the Moabites
verses.literalPt: Porém, chegando eles ao arraial de Israel, os israelitas se levantaram, e feriram os moabitas, os quais fugiram diante deles e ainda entraram nas suas terras, ferindo ali também os moabitas.

verses.original: וְהֶעָרִ֣ים יַהֲרֹ֡סוּ וְכָל־ חֶלְקָ֣ה ט֠וֹבָה יַשְׁלִ֨יכוּ אִישׁ־ אַבְנ֜וֹ וּמִלְא֗וּהָ וְכָל־ מַעְיַן־ מַ֤יִם יִסְתֹּ֙מוּ֙ וְכָל־ עֵֽץ־ ט֣וֹב יַפִּ֔ילוּ עַד־ הִשְׁאִ֧יר אֲבָנֶ֛יהָ בַּקִּ֖יר חֲרָ֑שֶׂת וַיָּסֹ֥בּוּ הַקַּלָּעִ֖ים וַיַּכּֽוּהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·he·‘ā·rîm ya·hă·rō·sū wə·ḵāl ḥel·qāh ṭō·w·ḇāh yaš·lî·ḵū ’îš- ’aḇ·nōw ū·mil·’ū·hā wə·ḵāl ma‘·yan- ma·yim yis·tō·mū wə·ḵāl ‘êṣ- ṭō·wḇ yap·pî·lū ‘aḏ- hiš·’îr ’ă·ḇā·ne·hā baq·qîr ḥă·rā·śeṯ way·yā·sōb·bū haq·qal·lā·‘îm way·yak·kū·hā
verses.literal: They destroyed the cities and each man threw stones on every good field until it was covered They stopped up every spring . . . and cut down every good tree Only Kir-haraseth was left with stones in place but men with slings surrounded it and attacked it as well
verses.literalPt: E arrasaram as cidades, e cada um lançou a sua pedra em todos os bons campos, e os entulharam, e entupiram todas as fontes de água, e cortaram todas as boas árvores, até que só em Quir-Haresete deixaram ficar as pedras, mas os fundeiros a cercaram e a feriram.

verses.original: וַיַּרְא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מוֹאָ֔ב כִּֽי־ חָזַ֥ק מִמֶּ֖נּוּ הַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וַיִּקַּ֣ח א֠וֹתוֹ שְׁבַע־ מֵא֨וֹת אִ֜ישׁ שֹׁ֣לֵֽף חֶ֗רֶב לְהַבְקִ֛יעַ אֶל־ מֶ֥לֶךְ אֱד֖וֹם וְלֹ֥א יָכֹֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar me·leḵ mō·w·’āḇ kî- ḥā·zaq mim·men·nū ham·mil·ḥā·māh way·yiq·qaḥ ’ō·w·ṯōw šə·ḇa‘- mê·’ō·wṯ ’îš šō·lêp̄ ḥe·reḇ lə·haḇ·qî·a‘ ’el- me·leḵ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm wə·lō yā·ḵō·lū
verses.literal: When the king of Moab saw that the battle was too fierce for him he took with him seven hundred swordsmen . . . . . . to break through to the king of Edom but they could not prevail . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas, vendo o rei dos moabitas que a peleja prevalecia contra ele, tomou consigo setecentos homens que sacavam espada, para romperem contra o rei de Edom, porém não puderam.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּח֩ אֶת־ בְּנ֨וֹ הַבְּכ֜וֹר אֲשֶׁר־ יִמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֗יו וַיַּעֲלֵ֤הוּ עֹלָה֙ עַל־ הַ֣חֹמָ֔ה וַיְהִ֥י קֶצֶף־ גָּד֖וֹל עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּסְעוּ֙ מֵֽעָלָ֔יו וַיָּשֻׁ֖בוּ לָאָֽרֶץ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- bə·nōw hab·bə·ḵō·wr ’ă·šer- yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw way·ya·‘ă·lê·hū ‘ō·lāh ‘al- ha·ḥō·māh way·hî qe·ṣep̄- gā·ḏō·wl ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl way·yis·‘ū mê·‘ā·lāw way·yā·šu·ḇū lā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: So he took his firstborn son who was to succeed him . . . and offered him as a burnt offering on the city wall And there was great fury against the Israelites so they withdrew . . . and returned to their own land
verses.literalPt: Então tomou a seu filho primogênito, que havia de reinar em seu lugar, e o ofereceu em holocausto sobre o muro; pelo que houve grande indignação em Israel; por isso retiraram-se dele, e voltaram para a sua terra.
